answer: A scripted farm thus has to pad 104 submissions and hold each account open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. Because the timing is written down against the terrace challenge, the bridge audit can replay the orchard history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 3 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
